I first tried to send all four in one transaction through the Disperse batch-payment contract, but it failed (tx 0x70b91383…888b). No ETH moved; you only paid the gas. It failed because three of the recipients (0x5da1, 0xf633 and 0x3391) are Safe multisig wallets, and Disperse gives each recipient too little gas for a Safe to accept ETH. Sending to each address directly doesn't have that limit.
